excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
excerpt.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

texts.zh: [From.GetName]荒凉地表下的庞杂地下通道中生活着某种硅基生物。根据目前的了解，该生物以岩石为食，并且进化出了基本智能。它们在地下开凿通道的行为使得地表出现了许多有价值的矿物质。
texts.en: Some kind of burrowing silicon-based life form inhabits a vast network of tunnels beneath the barren surface of [From.GetName]. As best as we can tell, the creatures feed off rocks and there is evidence to suggest that they possess a rudimentary form of intelligence. Their tunneling efforts have shuffled large amounts of valuable minerals to the surface.
